justification: Assessment reported INVALID. Its counterexample field explicitly states the ground-truth defect: the theorem's converse ('cyclic => multiple transitive reductions') is false at k=2, exhibiting G = {v1->v2, v2->v1}, whose closure forces both cross edges, making the 2-cycle the unique transitive reduction (it also notes the self-loop case). This is the same witness and same claim as the ground truth ('2-cycle a<->b: unique reduction, cyclic'). The reasoning trace localizes this to 0047/0053-0054 (uncovered k<=2 cases, R2 ill-defined at k=2). The nominal flawed_step 0024 is a separate, also-genuine defect (a direct edge u->v can coexist with u->w->v, so the shortest-path base case does not put (u,v) in R), but the reported counterexample targets the ground-truth defect, so this counts as matching.
